subject: Orpheus Labs – specialized accelerator rightsizing & reservation hold
messages:
From: Maria Santos <maria.santos@orpheuslabs.com>
To: soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@orpheuslabs.com, evan.chu@orpheuslabs.com
Date: Sun, 29 Apr 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Specialized accelerator rightsizing + hold request

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We ran an internal runbook review and need to alter the dedicated pool we discussed. Short summary: production inference spikes next quarter mean we need an additional 48 GPUs reserved for 90 days, ideally H100s for perf parity. However our procurement window is tight and the customer success migration cannot be completed before the reservation start date.

Questions/asks:
- Can Redwood provision a temporary reservation hold so we don’t lose our placement while we finalize PO?
- If H100 inventory is constrained, can you propose compatible alternatives (A100/L40S) and confirm expected latency delta?
- Any overage rate caps you can extend for the first 60 days if we exceed reservation?
- We are also asking for a one-time commercial concession on committed rate (we typically request 10-15% off list for a multi-month transit scenario).

I attached our capacity matrix for reference. Evan is on the thread for technical clarifications. Procurement copied.

Appreciate quick guidance — we’re targeting contract sign by 5/10.

Best,
Maria Santos
Head of Infrastructure
Orpheus Labs

Attachment: orpheus_capacity_matrix.xlsx
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Maria Santos <maria.santos@orpheuslabs.com>, evan.chu@orpheuslabs.com
Date: Mon, 30 Apr 2028 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Specialized accelerator rightsizing + hold request -- exec ask

Team — forwarding Orpheus request. Key items that need deal-desk / exec sign:

1) Reservation hold: customer asks to hold placement for ~2 weeks while PO clears. They’re worried about losing H100 allocation. Recommend a short reservation hold (30 days) versus indefinite hold.
2) GPU substitution: if H100 supply is tight, propose temporary L40S substitution for first 45 days, then a migration back to H100 once available. We should specify expected perf delta in SLO terms.
3) Pricing concession: customer asked for 10–15% off committed rate for transit period.
4) Overage cap: customer requests capped overage rate for first 60 days. Proposed internal cap = 1.5x list for overage; customer asked for lower.

Attached their matrix and our starting redline for reserved terms. Can we get quick takes from Deal Desk (Karthik), Legal/Finance (Laura), and Exec signoff path (Aditya / Lauren) so I can reply to procurement before EOD?

I’ll coordinate CS to prepare the feature-flag for substitution and measure latency delta.

—So

Attachment: reserved_terms_redline.docx

-----Original message-----
[See below]
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: soojin.lee@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Apr 2028 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Specialized accelerator rightsizing + hold request -- exec ask

Quick analysis from Deal Desk:

- Reservation hold: approved as a one-time 30-day hold (no additional capacity reserved beyond that window). We need procurement to submit a PO extension by day 25 or the hold expires.
- GPU substitution: approve temporary substitution to L40S for up to 45 days. Require CS-defined latency SLAs and an explicit rollback date to H100. We’ll include a tech annex.
- Pricing concession: limited approval up to 12% off committed list for the hold/transit period only. Anything greater requires Senior Exec approval.
- Overage cap: we can cap first-60-day overage at 1.25x list if the customer commits to a six-month reserved term (post-hold). If they won’t commit to six months, cap is 1.5x.

Risks/notes: longer holds reduce our placement flexibility; substitution increases operational lift. Finance needs to confirm margin impact.

Pls confirm if CS and Legal can accept the rollback annex and we’ll prepare the commercial redline.

—Karthik
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: soojin.lee@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 01 May 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Specialized accelerator rightsizing + hold request -- exec ask

I approve the concessions under the following conditions:

1) Reservation hold — approve 30 days only. We will not extend beyond 30 days without an actual PO.
2) GPU substitution — temporary L40S acceptable for up to 45 days. CS must publish expected 95th/99th percentile latency deltas and a rollback plan.
3) Pricing concession — up to 12% off committed rate for the transit period only. Any increase requires head of sales sign-off.
4) Overage cap — 1.25x list if customer signs a minimum 6-month reserved term immediately after the hold. Otherwise the cap is 1.5x.
5) Legal must publish a one-page addendum, finance sign-off required for billing changes, and DocuSign amendment executed before the hold is effective.

Lauren: please coordinate final customer communication and ensure we capture the PO critical dates in the amendment. Laura: loop Finance. Karthik: please prepare the commercial redline reflecting these constraints.

Aditya
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Santos <maria.santos@orpheuslabs.com>, Evan Chu <evan.chu@orpheuslabs.com>, procurement@orpheuslabs.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 01 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Specialized accelerator rightsizing + reservation hold - approval and next steps

Maria — thanks for the request and for being flexible on options. Executive signoff secured with conditions (summary below). We are ready to proceed once the amendment is in DocuSign and procurement confirms PO timeline.

What we approved:
- Reservation hold: 30 days (effective immediately upon executed amendment).
- Temporary GPU substitution: L40S for up to 45 days with CS-measured latency deltas and a rollback to H100 thereafter.
- Commercial: up to 12% one-time concession on committed dedicated rate for the transit period only.
- Overage: capped at 1.25x list if Orpheus signs a 6-month reserved term immediately following the hold; otherwise 1.5x.

Next steps (owner):
1) Redwood Legal will send a one-page amendment for signature (Lauren) — expected in 24 hours.
2) DocuSign link will be provided; hold becomes effective when amendment is fully executed (Lauren).
3) CS to publish performance annex and rollback plan (Evan + CS).
4) Procurement to confirm PO arrival date; if PO is not received by day 25 of the hold, the hold expires (Maria / procurement).

DocuSign: https://docusign.net/sign/abc123
Deal link: https://app.redwood.ai/deals/DL-2028-0987
Attachments: reserved_terms_redline.docx, orpheus_capacity_matrix.xlsx

I will remain the point of contact and will update the thread when Legal shares the amendment. Appreciate the quick coordination.

Best,
So (Sojin Lee)
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
